input.plan:
# Professional mobile chrome redesign

`design.md` stays the locked system (Warm Horizon, Lexend + Manrope, orange primary / navy ink). This is an in-place visual/interaction redesign of chrome and rhythm — not a new theme and not a deletion of existing pages or sections.

## What is actually broken

Inspected live at 375px (signed-in session).

**1. Marketing header crowds itself** — every marketing page via [`homepage/components/Header.tsx`](homepage/components/Header.tsx)

The row is logo (`min-w-0`) + avatar + **Open workspace** (136px) + hamburger (44px). The wordmark needs ~125px; the right cluster is `shrink-0` and steals the row, so **KUCHUP clips and paints under the orange button**. Confirmed: lockup `scrollWidth` 125 vs `clientWidth` 75.

**2. Apply tabs vanish off-screen** — [`relocation_jobs/static/apply.html`](relocation_jobs/static/apply.html) + [`.apply-tabs` in `styles.css`](relocation_jobs/static/styles.css)

Five `white-space: nowrap` tabs in a non-wrapping flex row. `html { overflow-x: clip }` hides **Connect MCP** (and clips **Interview notes** to “Intervie”). No scroll, no wrap of the row, no overflow menu.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph broken [375px apply tabs]
    P[Profile]
    M[Master resumes]
    Pr[Projects]
    I["Intervie…"]
    C[Connect MCP off-canvas]
  end
  P --- M --- Pr --- I
  C -.->|clipped| I
```

**3. App pages still load Inter** — [`apply.html`](relocation_jobs/static/apply.html), [`company.html`](relocation_jobs/static/company.html), [`admin.html`](relocation_jobs/static/admin.html) while the board ([`index.html`](relocation_jobs/static/index.html)) already loads Lexend/Manrope. That split is why /apply looks like a different, cheaper product.

Same tab-row pattern exists on [`.company-artifact-tabs`](relocation_jobs/static/styles.css) (CV / Cover letter).

## Design direction (still Warm Horizon)

Professional SaaS chrome, not a toy floating chip:

- Marketing nav: full-bleed sticky bar flush to the top (drop `sticky top-3` + floating rounded island). Mobile: **wordmark + menu only**. Sign-in / Open workspace / identity move into the sheet. Desktop keeps links + CTA.
- Apply: slim toolbar + sticky **scrollable tab rail** (labels stay one line; the row scrolls, labels never wrap — Hallmark gate 49). Header actions collapse to a compact pair or overflow, not two full-width stacked pills eating the viewport.
- Shared `.tab-rail` for apply + company artifact tabs: `overflow-x: auto`, `flex: 0 0 auto`, thin scrollbar / edge fade, 44px height.
- Align app HTML font links to Lexend/Manrope. Fix `/apply` `theme-color` (`#090b10` is leftover dark chrome).

Copy, routes, tokens, and existing homepage sections (Hero, ProductJourney, Access, FAQ, etc.) stay. No invented metrics. No component directory deletions.

## Workstreams

### A. Marketing chrome + rhythm

- [`homepage/components/Header.tsx`](homepage/components/Header.tsx) — restructure mobile cluster; put AuthCta in the sheet; `shrink-0` on the lockup; never clip the wordmark.
- [`homepage/components/AuthCta.tsx`](homepage/components/AuthCta.tsx) — mobile loading state must not reserve a wide empty orange pill; shorter header label (“Board” / “Sign in”) if a compact desktop CTA remains.
- [`homepage/components/BrandMark.tsx`](homepage/components/BrandMark.tsx) — lockup must not shrink under the CTA.
- [`homepage/app/globals.css`](homepage/app/globals.css) — full-bleed `nav-glass`; more hero padding under the bar; slightly stronger `.hero-lede` contrast (`--text-secondary` is light at 375px); CTA rows stay wrap-the-row, not wrap-the-label ([`.landing-close-actions`](homepage/app/globals.css), pricing card buttons).

### B. Apply as a product settings surface

- [`relocation_jobs/static/apply.html`](relocation_jobs/static/apply.html) — toolbar markup; Lexend/Manrope; bump `styles.css?v=`.
- [`relocation_jobs/static/styles.css`](relocation_jobs/static/styles.css) — `.tab-rail` / `.apply-tabs` scroll; compact `.admin-header` on small screens (stop the 1-column full-width **Job panel** / **Sign out** stack); denser form rhythm without shrinking 44px targets.
- [`relocation_jobs/static/js/apply.js`](relocation_jobs/static/js/apply.js) — only if tab activation needs `scrollIntoView` for the active chip (no layout JS otherwise).

### C. Shared app chrome

- Font links: apply / company / admin match the board.
- `.company-artifact-tabs` uses the same `.tab-rail`.
- Pass over [`relocation_jobs/static/index.html`](relocation_jobs/static/index.html) header at 375px while signed in — filters already collapse; fix any leftover nowrap button clip (Admin / Add company text).

### D. Tokens / design.md

Amend [`design.md`](design.md) chrome notes only: marketing nav is full-bleed sticky; mobile primary CTA lives in the menu; tab rails scroll rather than wrap labels. Do not change palette, type, or CTA fill.

## Out of scope unless you say otherwise

- Rewriting homepage section copy or deleting ProductJourney / MCP / country blocks
- New color system or dark theme
- Rebuilding the job-card workbench interaction model
- Deploy to EC2 (local + static export only unless you ask)

## Verification

Browser at **320 / 375 / 414 / 768**: `/`, `/pricing`, `/mcp`, `/apply`, `/panel` (signed in), one company workspace.

- Wordmark fully visible; no orange CTA over the logo
- All five apply tabs reachable (scroll or visible); labels one line
- No horizontal page scroll (`overflow-x: clip` on html/body stays)
- Touch targets ≥ 44px
- After homepage CSS/TSX edits, run [`scripts/build_homepage.sh`](scripts/build_homepage.sh) so Flask static export matches
